scenario.title: LAKE BALATON COUNTERATTACK - 16 MAR 1945
intro.text:
LAKE BALATON COUNTERATTACK - 16 MAR 1945

East of Lake Balaton, Hungary

The German offensive flagged - the enemy isn't be able to break through to the Danube. Time for us to attack. Advance to Lake Balaton and crush the enemy formations!

ORDERS
Capture all VH!

NOTES
Attention - winter conditions! If possible, equip your troops with tracked movement. Check if you can switch between wheeled and tracked movement for free.
header.location: East of Lake Balaton, Hungary — 16 March 1945
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.reaction-briliant.text: Belgrade was liberated with the three commands meeting on schedule. Each liaison team now remembers that schedule as its own proposal.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.reaction-victory.text: The sectors joined inside Belgrade and the German corridor is broken. Ask the liaison teams which arrangements worked; we'll need those again.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.reaction-tactical.text: Belgrade is free, but part of the German force escaped between our sectors. The three commands disagree about which gap mattered. Get their reports together before we move on.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.callback-choice-a.text: The Partisan officers remember that you let them choose their own routes into Belgrade. Speak to them before they leave; they've been willing to tell us what our maps missed.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.callback-choice-b.text: One axis made the Belgrade fire plan manageable. The traffic was another matter. Our allies waited on roads we'd allocated to ourselves. I need to hear their complaints too.
line.scene-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.scene-0.text: There are recovery crews towing tanks both ways on the attack road. Ours and captured German ones. Can I clear a lane, or does every workshop get to stop the counterattack?
line.scene-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.scene-1.text: I know which tractors belong to the crews sleeping under those tanks. Give them a little warning before you wake them. In Spain I wouldn't have thought to ask.
line.scene-2.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-2.text: The prisoners say they were supposed to recover the Hungarian position. Their bowsers are empty and the recovery units are still east of the lake. They'll start getting out as soon as they can tow.
line.decision.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.decision.text: The enemy is disordered now. We can attack before our own formations refit, or spend a day restoring fuel and ammunition while accepting that more German armour will escape west.
Launch the counterattack before the enemy can disengage from the failed offensive.
Release an eight-strength SU-100 detachment with 50 experience and fully refuel the core; emergency commitment costs 120 prestige.
line.decision.choice.refit-then-strike.t: Clear the roads, replenish the formations, and attack as a fully supplied force.
line.decision.choice.refit-then-strike.h: Restore every core formation to full strength, fuel, and ammunition and give tanks and artillery 15 experience each; refit priority costs 60 prestige.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-a-0.text: Leading units attack on the fuel they have. Recovery and supply follow one road behind; no formation turns back merely because its paperwork says the offensive starts tomorrow.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-1.text: I'll report which German units are recovering. Pavel, give me our fuel limits as well. I need to know how long the leading vehicles can keep contact.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-b-0.text: The attack begins after every mobile formation reports fuel and ammunition. We may meet a cleaner enemy line, but we will strike it with a coherent army.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-b-1.text: For once, the day of preparation is mine. Clear the roads, wake the crews after the bowsers arrive, and do not let Volkov turn one day into two.
line.post-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.post-0.text: Clear the lane for recovery and bring me fuel returns at dusk. Pavel, tell the crew commanders when they can expect the bowsers.
